title: Advanced module: workflow managers (Nextflow/Snakemake)
context: Workflow managers (Nextflow, Snakemake) are increasingly required for reproducible multi-step analyses in cancer research, especially for bioinformatics pipelines. This advanced module is deferred from M1 to the backlog because the core curriculum covers only a conceptual introduction to workflow managers — the advanced module requires more advanced learners and a larger time investment. It should only be taken on after the core modules are published and a teaching cohort is available. Any worked example must pass the data gate (datagate-002).
objective: Author an advanced module on workflow managers (Nextflow and/or Snakemake) targeted at cancer researchers with some computational background, with a runnable container-based exercise and a gated worked example on an open cancer dataset; CI green; reviewed by Educator, Domain, Data & licensing, and Technical reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Module covers Nextflow and/or Snakemake at a depth appropriate for bench scientists who have completed the core curriculum and are ready for multi-step pipeline automation.

At least one gated worked example on an open cancer dataset with a committed PASS gate artifact (datagate-002 criteria: permitsDerivatives: true, non-identifiable); data fetched at runtime; no raw data committed.
Hands-on exercise runs in a pinned container and passes CI (Docker + Apptainer).
Example is purely methodological; labeled 'teaching example — not a finding, not advice.'
All lesson assertions cited; link/citation checker passes in CI.
Reviewed and signed off by Educator, Domain, Data & licensing, and Technical reviewers; DCO signed off.
resources: PLAN.md (Scope — backlog; workflow managers deferred from M1)
The Turing Way — reproducible pipelines chapter
output: A complete advanced 'Workflow managers' module committed to the project repo with CI green, gated worked example (PASS gate artifact), and all four reviewer sign-offs.
